name: PT Jasa Marga (Persero) Tbk
summary: Founded in 1978 and headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia, PT Jasa Marga (Persero) Tbk (PTJSY) is an Indonesian corporation dedicated to the comprehensive development, construction, operation, management, and maintenance of toll road infrastructure throughout the country. The company's services extend to critical functions such as toll transaction processing, traffic management, and specialized road construction. Additionally, it diversifies its activities through the rental of toll road equipment and vehicles, as well as engaging in real estate development. Presently, PT Jasa Marga is responsible for operating thirteen separate toll road networks.
